title.zh: Anabranch Core · Java 8 与 Android 多源分块下载库
title.en: Anabranch Core · Multi-Source Segmented Downloader for Java 8 & Android

summary.zh: 面向 Java 8 与 Android (minSdk 21) 的无第三方依赖多源分块下载库，支持多镜像分块下载、失败换源重试、断点续传与哈希校验，另附可选的 aria2 JNI 后端。
summary.en: Zero-dependency multi-source segmented download library for Java 8 and Android (minSdk 21) with mirror failover, resume support, digest verification, and an optional aria2 JNI backend.

zh: 核心模块使用纯 Java 8 编写，不依赖第三方库或 Android 专有 API，可直接用于 minSdk 21 项目
支持从多个镜像源同时拉取不同分块，按下载速度分配剩余分块，并在合并前校验文件摘要
除纯 Java 实现外，还提供了一个单独打包的 aria2 JNI 原生下载后端模块
en: Core module written in plain Java 8 with zero third-party dependencies, compatible with Android minSdk 21
Downloads segments across multiple mirrors, schedules chunks by speed, and verifies file digests
Provides an optional standalone aria2 JNI native backend artifact alongside the pure-Java engine

milestone.zh: 已完成纯 Java 分块下载核心与 aria2 JNI 模块的单元测试和编译流水线。
milestone.en: Pure-Java segmented downloader and optional aria2 JNI module are tested and built via CI.
